questions.prompt: Let X1,...,Xn be iid Uniform(0,theta), theta>0. (a) Write the likelihood including support. (b) Find an MLE. (c) Explain why an interior score equation is insufficient.
rubricDraft: a: theta^(-n) times indicator(theta >= max xi) for nonnegative sample
b: likelihood decreases on admissible domain; maximum at max xi (boundary convention declared)
c: parameter-dependent support invalidates naive interior-only optimisation
questions.assumptions: Synthetic convention: density at upper endpoint included; positive observed sample.

questions.prompt: For iid Exponential(rate lambda), lambda>0, derive expected Fisher information for one observation and for n observations.
Known variance 4, normal iid sample, n=16, mean=11. Test H0: mu=10 versus H1: mu>10 at 5%; use critical value 1.645.
If each Xi has finite mean mu, prove the sample mean is unbiased. Is independence necessary?
rubricDraft: independence is unnecessary for this expectation argument

corpus.text: Uniform likelihood has parameter dependent support theta >= maximum sample. Interior score equations alone are insufficient.
Exponential rate lambda expected Fisher information per observation is 1/lambda^2; sample of size n has n/lambda^2.
For known variance, the one sided normal mean test uses Z=(mean-mu0)/(sigma/sqrt(n)) and rejects above the critical value.
Linearity of expectation proves the sample mean unbiased for a common finite mean; independence is unnecessary.
Byte addressed 32-bit word array address at index i is base plus 4*i; valid zero-based indexing required.
The synthetic MIPS contract has no delay slots. Sum aligned words with four-byte stride, guard zero length before load, modulo 2^32 arithmetic.
XOR truth table: 00 -> 0, 01 -> 1, 10 -> 1, 11 -> 0. Equivalent Boolean expressions are allowed.
Multiple select uses an exact-set key policy; correct pick and reasoning are assessed separately.
